data.exact_reserve_text: The result for Syndicate 1492 for the year ended 31 December 2019 is a profit of GBP 7,833,000 (2018: GBP 1,570,000), of which a loss of GBP 5,556,000 is attributable to the 2019 year of account, a profit of GBP 14,806,000 is attributable to the 2018 year of account and a loss of GBP 1,417,000 is attributable to the 2017 and prior years of account.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net profit of GBP 13.389 million attributable to prior years of account (2018 and 2017 & prior). However, a gross claims development triangle indicates a net strengthening of GBP 10.889 million (11.39% of opening gross reserves) for underwriting years 2017 and older. This strengthening is primarily driven by the 2017 underwriting year, with releases observed in 2016 and 2015. The report notes that the calendar year was benign with minimal major loss activity, but does not explicitly detail the causes for the prior year reserve movements.
